steps.en: Electronic reminder is sent to the individual owner after the 2nd letter
steps.id: Electronic reminder dikirim ke pemilik individu setelah surat ke-2
steps.why_en: The electronic reminder job is switched off in production settings, so it does not run there.
steps.why_id: Job electronic reminder dimatikan di pengaturan produksi, jadi tidak jalan di sana.

steps.en: The system checks whether the owner opted out of electronic reminders
steps.id: Sistem mengecek apakah pemilik memilih opt out dari electronic reminder
steps.why_en: The opt-out check is part of the reminder job, which is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Cek opt-out ada di job reminder, yang dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: The system checks and updates the individual owner's latest particulars
steps.id: Sistem mengecek dan memperbarui particulars terbaru pemilik individu
steps.why_en: The government-record check runs, but the second source of updates is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan data pemerintah jalan, tapi sumber update kedua dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: The notice moves to the 3rd-letter stage after the 2nd letter
steps.id: Notice naik ke stage surat ke-3 setelah surat ke-2

steps.en: The 3rd reminder letter is sent to the individual owner
steps.id: Surat reminder ke-3 dikirim ke pemilik individu
steps.why_en: The letter is prepared, but upload to the printer is blocked by configuration, so delivery cannot be shown.
steps.why_id: Surat disiapkan, tapi upload ke percetakan diblok lewat konfigurasi, jadi pengiriman tidak terbukti.
